methodology.description: Fundamentals-only scores remain unchanged. Sep 25 refresh re-underwrites every holding under a harsher global-duration + energy-inflation regime: US long yields remain above 5%, Japan's 10Y is above 3%, and crude/refined-product tightness has re-accelerated. Latest completed-session prices are used for canonical P/L; intraday moves are treated as tactical context rather than permanent score inputs.

holdings.name: ExxonMobil
holdings.status: Integrated quality holding · oil/product inflation supports cash flow, but geopolitical premium is not an add thesis
metrics: 1.6286 shares · latest $162.14 Sep 24 · value ~$264.06 · transferred cost basis unavailable
Q2 operating cash flow: $23.6B
Watch: $156–159 support held · $164–166 repair/reclaim · ~$176.4 major breakout
holdings.strength: Strong integrated cash generation, advantaged upstream assets and refining exposure make XOM a higher-quality way to own the current energy scarcity regime.
holdings.weakness: Oil above $100 can destroy demand and keep rates higher; do not treat geopolitical scarcity as permanent earnings power.
holdings.verdict: CORE HOLD / NO CHASE. Integrated upstream/refining exposure is relatively resilient in the current oil-plus-rates shock, but fresh capital still requires price discipline. $164–166 is the next repair/reclaim; avoid adding solely because crude spikes.

holdings.name: MISC Berhad
holdings.status: Hold · product/shipping tightness supportive, but Yinson funding/structure remains the add gate
metrics: 100 shares · avg RM8.30 · latest RM7.92 Sep 24 · value RM792 · P/L -RM38 (-4.58%)
Q2 revenue ~RM4.79B (+76% YoY); attributable profit ~RM1.15B (+149%)
Watch: RM7.75–7.90 support zone · RM8.00–8.10 first repair · RM8.30 then ~RM8.48 confirmation
holdings.strength: Tanker-rate strength and diversified maritime assets are converting current energy/logistics disruption into earnings and cash flow.
holdings.weakness: Potential Yinson-related transaction funding, leverage and capital-allocation risk can overwhelm the otherwise strong operating tape.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO ADD. Refined-product and shipping tightness support the operating backdrop, but route normalization and unresolved Yinson transaction/funding risk cap the asymmetry. Require funding clarity plus a price repair above RM8.00–8.10.

holdings.name: Hibiscus Petroleum Berhad
holdings.status: Hold · RM2.20 support repaired, but oil-beta strength still needs company/price confirmation
metrics: 1,000 shares · avg RM2.10 · latest RM2.30 Sep 24 · value RM2,300 · P/L +RM200 (+9.52%)
FY26 net profit ~RM361M (+207%); record full-year dividend 10 sen/share
Sep 24 was ex-dividend for 2 sen; watch RM2.20 support · RM2.30–2.35 hold/reclaim · ~RM2.46 breakout
holdings.strength: Production scale, sharply improved FY26 earnings and direct crude-price sensitivity provide real cash-flow leverage to the current oil regime.
holdings.weakness: Field decline, decommissioning obligations, production interruptions and oil-price reversals keep this a higher-beta holding than XOM.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO CHASE. The RM2.20 area repaired and >$100 crude is supportive, but Sep 24 ex-dividend effects and high oil volatility argue against extrapolating one rebound. Fresh capital needs RM2.30–2.35 to hold plus stable realized pricing/operations.

holdings.name: YTL Power International Berhad
holdings.status: Structural AI/power thesis strengthened operationally · financing hurdle and breakout still unresolved
metrics: 1,000 shares · avg RM3.83 · latest RM5.80 Sep 24 · value RM5,800 · P/L +RM1,970 (+51.44%)
Seven reserved Siemens SGT-9000HL turbines imply >5.25GW potential generation capacity, but capacity is not the same as funded/energised demand
Watch: RM5.65–5.70 support · ~RM6.02 breakout · ~RM6.14 confirmation
holdings.strength: Power, regulated water, telecom, data-centre and cloud assets provide unusually broad exposure to Malaysia's physical AI buildout.
holdings.weakness: Heavy capex, leverage and portfolio concentration matter more with global long yields above 5%; headline MW must convert through funding, interconnection, permits, customers and FCF.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO ADD. The physical-power thesis is stronger, but the capital-scarcity regime raises the proof threshold. Require ~RM6.02 then ~RM6.14 plus contracted load, credible financing/grid or self-supply, permits and FCF conversion.

holdings.name: YTL Power structured warrant / linked instrument
holdings.status: Track YTLPOWR parent + instrument terms only · standalone valuation still unavailable
metrics: Rakuten: 200 units · no reliable displayed valuation
Fundamental score is inherited from parent YTLPOWR, not a standalone warrant valuation
Track parent levels: RM5.65–5.70 support · ~RM6.02 breakout · ~RM6.14 confirmation
holdings.strength: Economic direction is primarily linked to YTLPOWR's underlying thesis and price.
holdings.weakness: Warrant terms, expiry, strike, liquidity and time decay can dominate returns; a parent-company score is not a warrant valuation.
holdings.verdict: TRACK PARENT / INSTRUMENT STATUS. Do not infer a target from YTLPOWR alone; strike, expiry, liquidity and time decay can dominate returns.

holdings.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
holdings.status: Elite franchise · fresh 15-session low; owned-position monitor, not a new-money research priority
metrics: Q1 FY2027 net bookings: $1.39B; recurrent spend 84% of revenue
Watch: ~$202–203 current floor area · ~$210 first repair · $216–217 confirmation · $228–233 stronger recovery
holdings.strength: Exceptional IP and GTA VI scale potential can drive a large step-up in bookings and cash generation.
holdings.weakness: Current profitability/cash flow remain weak relative to valuation, and higher real yields raise the hurdle for catalyst-duration assets.
holdings.verdict: HOLD BECAUSE OWNED / STOP NEW-MONEY RESEARCH FOR NOW. A fresh 15-session low plus 5%+ long yields makes the current asymmetry poor. Re-activate only after ~$210 is recovered, preferably $216–217, or materially better GTA VI cash-flow evidence arrives.

holdings.name: Tesla
holdings.status: Semi commercialization is a real incremental positive · still inside repair band and duration-sensitive
metrics: Tesla has begun Semi deliveries to initial customers, but disclosed pricing/production economics remain insufficient for a score change
Watch: $353–355 support · $375–383 repair/hold zone · ~$397 next confirmation
holdings.strength: Exceptional balance sheet, energy storage growth and autonomy/robotics optionality create multiple paths to upside.
holdings.weakness: Core auto economics and valuation leave little room for execution disappointment, especially with real yields elevated.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO ADD. Semi deliveries improve commercialization evidence but do not repair valuation or auto-economics risk. With long yields above 5%, require sustained >$383 then ~$397 before treating the tape as a confirmed breakout.

holdings.name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Berhad
holdings.status: Operating proof still missing · remove from new-money daily screen despite firmer crude
metrics: 400 shares · avg RM1.81 · latest RM1.47 Sep 24 · value RM588 · P/L -RM136 (-18.78%)
Q2 revenue ~RM161M (-40% YoY); attributable profit ~RM32.8M (-57% YoY); order book ~RM4.72B
Watch: RM1.42 critical support · RM1.50–1.52 recovery · ~RM1.57 breakout
holdings.strength: Healthier balance sheet, sizeable order book and offshore maintenance/OSV exposure retain cyclical upside if utilisation and work orders recover.
holdings.weakness: Latest revenue/profit contraction and weaker vessel utilisation show that high oil prices have not yet translated into operating momentum.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / DO NOT AVERAGE DOWN / NO NEW-MONEY RESEARCH. Higher crude is not enough; require utilization, work-order and earnings conversion plus RM1.50–1.52 recovery before reconsidering fresh capital.
